notes: WhaleChat 3.64.0 — installed-app offline mode (strict standalone detection, browser tabs locked out of offline trading with an install prompt); local-first IndexedDB device database for balances, holdings, watchlists, orders, pending trades and OHLCV candles; native canvas candlestick/line chart replacing third-party widgets with a LIVE MARKET / OFFLINE SIMULATED badge; offline volatility simulator seeded from the last real Finnhub/Twelve Data/Binance close; unified online & offline trading desk (market, limit, stop-loss, watchlists, portfolio analytics, cash⇄wallet transfers) with a deterministic FIFO reconciliation engine (clientOrderId idempotency, 2% slippage tolerance, live-price adjustment, OPEN conversion for untouched limit/stop orders, insufficient-funds protection) that syncs to Appwrite and sends Brevo receipts on reconnect; new server configuration (Appwrite nyc.cloud.appwrite.io, Telesign SMS OTP, Brevo email, Binance WebSocket) with Appwrite-hosted functions for both the site and the sync backend.
